name: Nibe Limited
summary: Nibe Limited engages in the fabrication and machining of components in the defense sector in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Defence and Aeronautics. The company offers fabrication, machining, and assembly of components used in defence systems, as well as the manufacturing and maintenance of various electronic and mechanical systems for naval, land, air, and space applications. It also provides products and services such as weapons, communication devices, protective vehicles, defensive and deterrence systems, and related components.
